parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term for order ID, customer name, or purchase order ID

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by (prefix with - for descending). Available: id, customerOrderId, purchaseOrderId, status, orderDate, total

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Include archived orders: 0 = active only, 1 = archived only

parameters.name: excluded
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of columns to exclude
